title: LRU 缓存
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: One complete static Chinese algorithm explanation image for Bamboo Copter's dark desktop app. Make the exact LRU mechanism understandable in one image.
Style: refined modern editorial educational infographic, flat precise diagrams, crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, balanced whitespace, readable labels. Landscape around 3:2, preferably 1536x1024. Deep charcoal background #171b20, warm white text, muted grey secondary text, restrained mint and amber accents. Main diagram occupies most of the canvas. Thin accurate arrows. No glossy 3D, mascot, decoration, fake app windows, play buttons, watermarks or full solution code. No excessive nested cards. Render only the specified content. All Chinese, symbols and numbers must be accurate and readable. Use English punctuation in Chinese text.
Title: "35  LRU 缓存". Subtitle: "哈希表定位节点, 双向链表维护使用顺序". Input directly underneath "LRUCache(2), 容量 C = 2".
Three visual sections and a compact complexity footer:
1. "两种结构, 同一批节点". Show one precise snapshot after "put(1,1), put(2,2), get(1)".
Draw an actual doubly linked chain exactly "head ⇄ [1:1] ⇄ [2:2] ⇄ tail". Use real arrowheads in both directions on every neighbor link, all 4 boxes align in one horizontal row. head and tail are grey sentinel boxes, the two data nodes are distinct. Annotate "MRU 最近使用" above node [1:1] and "LRU 最久未使用" above node [2:2]. Small legend "节点内容 key:value; head / tail 为哨兵".
Directly above or below the two data nodes show a tiny hash table with EXACT entries "1 → 节点(1,1)" and "2 → 节点(2,2)". One thin pointer arrow from each mapping to the correct corresponding REAL chain node. Mapping 1 lands on [1:1], mapping 2 lands on [2:2]. Never map to sentinels. Text "哈希表: key → 节点引用". Clearly label this snapshot "get(1) 返回 1, 节点 1 移到头部".
2. "容量为 2 的完整操作过程". A readable compact four-column table. Headings exactly "操作", "返回", "操作后 MRU → LRU", "逐出".
List these EXACT nine rows, no omitted or additional rows:
"put(1,1)" | "null" | "[1:1]" | "-"
"put(2,2)" | "null" | "[2:2, 1:1]" | "-"
"get(1)" | "1" | "[1:1, 2:2]" | "-"
"put(3,3)" | "null" | "[3:3, 1:1]" | "key 2"
"get(2)" | "-1" | "[3:3, 1:1]" | "-"
"put(4,4)" | "null" | "[4:4, 3:3]" | "key 1"
"get(1)" | "-1" | "[4:4, 3:3]" | "-"
"get(3)" | "3" | "[3:3, 4:4]" | "-"
"get(4)" | "4" | "[4:4, 3:3]" | "-"
These list snapshots are MRU to LRU order, not sorted key order. Highlight the two eviction rows with restrained amber, and two -1 miss results. Constructor returns null and cache starts empty; show small exact result line "输出 [null,null,null,1,null,-1,null,-1,3,4]".
3. "每次操作只改局部指针". Four short precise rules:
"get 命中 / put 更新: 摘下节点, 接到 head 后".
"put 新增: 新节点放到 head 后".
"超出容量: 删除 tail.prev, 同时删除哈希映射".
"get 未命中: 返回 -1, 顺序不变".
Do not draw decorative movement arrows or extra node examples, they risk incorrect pointer semantics.
Footer exactly: "get / put: 平均时间 O(1)    缓存空间 O(C)".
Second footer line exactly: "C 为缓存容量; 哈希表与节点共占 O(C), 单次操作辅助空间 O(1)".
Small footer note: "哈希操作按平均 O(1) 计; 冲突退化时最坏 O(C)".
No sorting, no scanning the whole chain, no move-to-tail behavior; MRU is always left and LRU is right.
edits:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied LRU explanation image. Make only this precise arrowhead correction in the left section's four-box chain head,1:1,2:2,tail.
For EACH of the three neighbor gaps, keep exactly TWO separate horizontal connectors:
- The UPPER connector is a single-direction right arrow from the LEFT box to the RIGHT box, representing next. Keep only the RIGHT arrowhead. Remove its LEFT arrowhead.
- The LOWER connector is a single-direction left arrow from the RIGHT box to the LEFT box, representing prev. Keep only the LEFT arrowhead. Remove its RIGHT arrowhead.
Apply this identically in gaps head to1:1,1:1 to2:2,2:2 totail. No individual line may have arrowheads on both ends. Do not make more than two lines per gap.
The desired top row is head → 1:1 → 2:2 → tail. The desired lower arrows are head ← 1:1 ← 2:2 ← tail.
Keep ALL other image pixels and content unchanged: Chinese text,9-row operation table, MRU/LRU positions, cache capacity, output array, complexity formulas, colors, boxes, the two downward hash-map pointer arrows. Do not redraw or modify the hash pointer arrows. Do not invent labels or extra nodes.

review.example: 题面容量2的完整操作序列已独立复算. 9步状态从 [1:1] 到 [2:2,1:1], get(1)后 [1:1,2:2], 插入3逐出2后 [3:3,1:1], 插入4逐出1后 [4:4,3:3], 最后get(3)/get(4)分别转为 [3:3,4:4]/[4:4,3:3]. 包含构造函数的完整输出 [null,null,null,1,null,-1,null,-1,3,4] 正确.
review.steps: 哈希表key1/key2的两根向下箭头分别落在真实节点1:1/2:2. get(1)快照为 head→1:1→2:2→tail, MRU左侧为1, LRU右侧为2. 已用官方imagegen修复重复双头箭头, 每对邻居上方单向next向右、下方单向prev向左, 各3根准确. table两次淘汰key2/key1、两次未命中不改顺序、两次尾节点命中后移头均准确.
review.complexity: get / put 平均时间 O(1), 哈希冲突退化时最坏 O(C). 缓存哈希表和节点整体空间 O(C), C为缓存容量; 单次操作辅助空间 O(1). 图中明确区分两种空间口径.
review.text: 已对修图后的项目实际PNG使用original核查全图. head/tail哨兵、MRU/LRU、key:value、table所有返回值与顺序、null输出和平均复杂度可读准确; 无完整提交代码或动画措辞.
